decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already adds the SK6812 Mini-E LEDs to the normal-operation DCDC1 3.3V load coverage; no additional update or removal is required.
Adding the LEDs to the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail does not change USB data routing, enumeration, flashing, or the existing ability to program without the power board.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the SK6812 Mini-E selection and its 3.3V supply requirement; the source decision entails no further LED-interface attribute change.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the daughterboard's SK6812 Mini-E part and 3.3V supply; no additional daughterboard state change is necessary.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the SK6812 Mini-E part and 3.3V supply for the addressable charge-status LEDs; connector and charge-status behavior remain unchanged.
The confirmed 3.3V LED supply does not change the current 5V boost configuration or powered-load list, which already excludes the SK6812 LEDs.
The loads powered by the standalone 3.3V rail do not affect USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or sourceability requirements.
The existing normal-operation coverage of all system loads already encompasses the LEDs, so the source decision does not require a new AXP2101 power-path attribute.
Powering the LEDs from the standalone 3.3V rail does not change the sensor board's external connector-fanout role.
The added 3.3V LED load does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
The standalone rail's expanded load coverage does not change the selected ESP32-S3 controller family.
The source decision does not specify any change to interboard connectors, pin assignments, interface partitioning, or pin-order policy.
